about: CCSC Technology International Holdings Limited, through its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacturing and sale of interconnect products in Europe, Asia, and the Americas. It offers original equipment manufacturing and original design manufacturing interconnect products, such as connectors, cables, and wire harnesses for use in industrial, automotive, robotics, medical equipment, computer, network and telecommunication, and consumer products. The company is also involved in the purchase of components; and manufacturing of other electrical equipment. It serves electronic manufacturing service and manufacturing companies. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Sha Tin, Hong Kong. CCSC Technology International Holdings Limited operates as a subsidiary of CCSC Investment Limited.
